fullPassage: Where scientific research is concerned, explanatory tales are expected to adhere closely to experimental data and to illuminate the regular and predictable features of experience. However, this paradigm sometimes conceals the fact that theories are deeply loaded with creative elements that shape the construction of research projects and the interpretations of evidence. Scientific explanations do not just relate a chronology of facts. They construct frameworks for systematically chosen data in order to provide a consistent and meaningful explanation of what is observed. Such constructions lead us to imagine specific kinds of subject matter in particular sorts of relations, and the storylines they inspire will prove more effective for analyzing some features of experience over others. When we neglect the creative contributions of such scientific imagination and treat models and interpretive explanations as straightforward facts — even worse, as facts including all of reality — we can blind ourselves to the limitations of a given model and fail to note its potential for misunderstanding a situation to which it ill applies.

det.tip: (A) framework = 이론적 틀 vs (B) framework = 물리적 골조

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "to keep something secret or hidden"

det.korean: conceal=숨기다: 무언가를 비밀로 또는 감춰진 상태로 유지하다
det.analysis:
❌ ① illuminate: illuminate(밝히다)는 숨기다의 반대
✅ ② conceal: conceal(숨기다)은 영영 정의에 정확히 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ construct: construct(구성하다)는 만드는 행위
❌ ④ neglect: neglect(간과하다)는 무시이지 숨기기가 아님
det.tip: conceal = to keep something secret or hidden

questions.passage: They construct frameworks for systematically chosen data in order to provide a consistent and __________ (meaning) explanation of what is observed.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: meaning → meaningful: 명사를 형용사로 변환 (의미 있는)
det.analysis: consistent and __________ (meaning) explanation — and로 연결된 병렬구조에서 형용사 필요. meaningful

questions.passage: Such constructions lead us to imagine specific kinds of subject matter in particular sorts of relations, and the storylines they inspire will prove more effective for __________ (analyze) some features of experience over others.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: analyze → analyzing: 전치사 for 뒤에 동명사(V-ing) 필요
det.analysis: for __________ (analyze) — 전치사 for 뒤에 동명사가 필요. analyzing
det.tip: for analyzing — 전치사 for + 동명사 = ~을 분석하는 데

questions.passage: Where scientific research is concerned, explanatory tales are expected to adhere closely to experimental data and to illuminate the regular and predictable features of experience. However, this paradigm sometimes conceals the fact that theories are deeply loaded with __________ that shape the construction of research projects and the interpretations of evidence. Scientific explanations do not just relate a chronology of facts. They construct frameworks for systematically chosen data in order to provide a consistent and meaningful explanation of what is observed. Such constructions lead us to imagine specific kinds of subject matter in particular sorts of relations, and the storylines they inspire will prove more effective for analyzing some features of experience over others. When we neglect the creative contributions of such scientific imagination and treat models and interpretive explanations as straightforward facts — even worse, as facts including all of reality — we can blind ourselves to the limitations of a given model and fail to note its potential for misunderstanding a situation to which it ill applies.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: creative elements=창의적 요소 (이론에 깊이 담겨 있으며 연구의 구성을 형성하는 것)
det.analysis:
❌ ① experimental data: 실험 데이터는 설명의 근거이지 이론에 내재된 것이 아님
❌ ② predictable features: 예측 가능한 특성은 밝혀야 할 대상이지 이론에 담긴 것이 아님
❌ ③ chronological facts: 연대기적 사실은 단순 나열이며 글이 비판하는 것
✅ ④ creative elements: 원문 일치. 'theories are deeply loaded with creative elements' ←정답
det.tip: deeply loaded with creative elements
